original: Hello. How may I help you today?
I was trying to look on the website but it is going really slow. Are you aware of any problems? I'm trying to figure out if it's on my end or yours.
Sure lets try and get that fixed for you. I have a few things we can try.
Can you try a different site for me?
Yeah, I went to Target's website and it seems fine.
Can you try logging out then back in?
I'm logged back on but it's still hardly loading.
Can you close all extra tabs and shut down any programs running?
Alright, that seemed to work. I guess another web page was causing the problem?
That is very possible. Im glad it working as it should now. Is there anything else I can help you with?
That's all I needed, thanks for helping!
